goal: Agent memory write policy review: who or what may write to memory, and whether injected text can change it.
use: Agent memory write policy review: who or what may write to memory, and whether injected text can change it. Use when untrusted content can reach the agent's memory.

steps.note: List the writers. Which users, tools and documents can add to memory.
Check the trust. Flag writes from untrusted sources, such as web pages or emails.
Check for injected instructions. Flag stored text that tells the agent how to behave.
Check the review. Confirm a person or a rule approves sensitive writes.
Report. Each writer, its trust level, the risk and the control.
